tables: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'
owner: SELECT owner FROM knovv_identity WHERE id=1
publication: SELECT digest,generation,vault,epoch FROM publications WHERE id=1
object-reserve: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO objects(id,size) SELECT ?,? WHERE (SELECT bytes FROM usage WHERE id=1)+?<=?
object-state: SELECT size,uploaded FROM objects WHERE id=?
object-verified: UPDATE objects SET uploaded=1 WHERE id=?
device-upsert: INSERT INTO devices(id,signing_public,generation,revoked,envelope) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET generation=excluded.generation,revoked=excluded.revoked,envelope=excluded.envelope WHERE excluded.generation>devices.generation AND excluded.signing_public=devices.signing_public
device-read: SELECT envelope FROM devices WHERE id=?
publication-cas: UPDATE publications SET generation=?,epoch=?,digest=?,envelope=? WHERE id=1 AND digest=? AND vault=?
publication-digest: SELECT digest FROM publications WHERE id=1
snapshot-cutoff: SELECT 'publication' kind,envelope value FROM publications UNION ALL SELECT 'device',envelope FROM devices UNION ALL SELECT 'cutoff',CAST(COALESCE(MAX(seq),0) AS TEXT) FROM revisions
object-page: SELECT id,size FROM objects WHERE uploaded=1 AND id>? ORDER BY id LIMIT ?
revision-page: SELECT seq,envelope FROM revisions WHERE seq>? AND seq<=? ORDER BY seq LIMIT ?
